title: Interleave two arrays
prompt:
Build a new array alternating elements from `a` and `b` (a first). When one runs out, append the remainder of the other. Implement `process(int[] a, int[] b)` — note the two-parameter shape `interleave`.

Example: `{1,2,3}` and `{9,9}` → `{1,9,2,9,3}`.

tests.name: interleaved with drain
tests.hint: Advance whichever cursor still has elements; the drain phase must append the longer list's tail.
